description: This file contains JavaScript code for the setup wizard page in an ERPNext application. It defines page load behavior, setup steps including domain selection, branding, organization details, and fiscal year configuration, with functions for validation, dynamic UI updates, and modal dialogs.

methods.name: bind_events
methods.description: Binds event handlers for company name and abbreviation inputs, including auto-generation of abbreviation and validation.

methods.name: validate_fy_dates
methods.description: Validates that the fiscal year start and end dates are valid and logically ordered.

methods.name: set_fy_dates
methods.description: Automatically sets fiscal year start and end dates based on the selected country and current date.

methods.name: load_chart_of_accounts
methods.description: Loads chart of accounts options based on selected country.

methods.name: charts_modal
methods.description: Displays a modal dialog with a tree view of chart of accounts, with options to expand or collapse all nodes.
